generalCriterionList.description: Regarding GSTNote- aThe amount put to tender is exclusive of G.S.T b G.S.T shall be paid to the tendered amount separately as per prevailing Government order. cThe increase in GST shall not be paid in the exteneded period of contractor for which the contractor alone is responsible for delay as determined by the authority while granting the extension of time

The Tender is invited in Two Cover system as per the following details.1) The tenderer should submit the following documents along with the tender a)A copy of the Registered Class-III and above b)Latest copy of the Income tax returns (ITR-V) filed for the year 2025-26 mentioning PAN number.C)Valid Employees provident fund (EPF) registration certificate with latest paid challan. d)Valid GST Registration certificate.e)Liquid assets and oror availability of credit facilities of not less than Rs. 30.00 lakhs. (Credit linesor letter of creditor Certificates from Banks for meeting the fund requirement etc. f)The tenderer should have Satisfactorily completed (at least 90percent of contract value) as a prime contractor, at least one similar work such as Construction of community hall / Buildings etc of value not less than 50percent of the amount put to tender ( i.e. Rs. 50.00 Lakhs) in the last five years period is that from 2021-22 to 2025-26, should be uploaded. Duly giving 10 percent escalation every year The work done should be obtained from a competent authority not below the rank of Executive Engineer of the concerned division.g)Each Tenderer in his name should have in the last five years i.e. 2021-22, 2022-23,2023-24,2024-25,2025-26, Executed in any one year, the following quantities of work-1)Excavation/embankment -11.88 cum 2) CC M15 and above grade concrete (PCC & RCC)-70.77 cum 3) Steel Reinforcement -50.04 Tonne.h)Each tenderer Achieved in at least Two Financial years an average Financial Turnover of Rs.100.00 lakhs. The turnover prior to FY 2025-26 will be updated to the Present Price Level by giving weight age of 10 percent each year. Audited Profit and Loss account certified by a practicing Chartered Accountant bearing UDIN along with copy of Income Tax returns filed for the years indicated above should be furnished. FY 2025-26. All documentorcertificates issued by a Charted Accountant should have a UDIN (Unique Document Identification Number) generated through the ICAI (The Institude of chartered Accountants of India) Portal. Certificate without UDIN the documents uploaded will be considered and treated as invalid document.i)Each of the documents uploaded to the e-portal should be self-attested by the contractor or an authorized representative in case of firm orcompany.j)Tenderers who meet the above specified minimum qualifying criteria, will only be qualified, if their available tender capacity is more than the total tender value. The available tender capacity will be calculated as under-Assessed available tender capacity equall (AxNx2.5- B) where A equallMaximum value of civil engineering works executed in any one year during the last five years (2021-22 to 2025-26) (Updated to 2026-27 price level) taking into account the completed as well as works in progress.N equall Number of years prescribed for completion of the works for which Tenders are invited.B equallValue, at 2025-26 price level, of existing commitments and on-going works to be completed during the next 6 months (period of completion of the works for which Tenders are invited) Note-The statements showing the value of existing commitments and on-going works as well as the stipulated period of completion remaining for each of the works listed should be countersigned by the Employer in charge, not below the rank of an Executive Engineer or equivalent.
The intending bidders are advised to visit the site of work before submission of the tenders.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

Within 20 days of receipt of the Letter of Acceptance, the successful Tenderer shall deliver to the Employer a Security deposit in any of the forms given below for an amount equivalent to 5% of the Contract price plus full difference amount for below quoted tenders as additional security (for unbalanced tenders) in accordance

The necessary certificates / documents in support of eligibility criteria fulfilled as stipulated shall be scanned and attached to e-tender document. The Original certificates/documents shall be produced on or before stipulated date and time for verification. Scanned signature of the bidder/authorized representative of the bidder shall be attached while uploading bid document
If any of the dates mentioned above happen to be a general holiday, the next working day holds good.

The contractor should take still photos / videos of the work before commencement of works, during execution and after completion compulsorily. These photos/ videos should be made available to the implementing officer, for immediate reference during review of works to enclose it with completion certificate

The bidder at the time of execution of the agreement should give a detailed execution plan and fortnightly program to complete the work in full manner in 6 months without fail. The program can be modified with mutual consent

The work will be constantly monitored by the Executive Engineer and if there is any slippage in achieving the program/ milestones month wise, a penalty / liquidated damages as indicated in the agreement / tender document would be levied. However, these liquidated damages will be refunded if the contractor makes good the shortfall in the subsequent months or completes the whole work before the stipulated date of completion
Conditional tenders are liable to be rejected. The officer competent to accept the tender shall have the right to reject any or all the tenders without assigning any reason whatsoever
Corrigendum will be published in web site for all modifications/corrections if any

The intending bidders should note that, if any of lands either in part/parts or whole required for the work is not acquired by the Nigam, it shall be the responsibility of the bidder to take possession of such land and start the work by the consent of the land owners before commencement of work at no extra cost to the Nigam and no claim whatsoever relating to non availability of land would be entertained
The contractor should mention their recent correct postal address and e-mail address in the declaration form
Incomplete tender documents will be rejected

All materials like steel, cement etc., required for the above work should be procured by the contractor only at his own cost. And these materials will have to be got tested by the competent authority before put to use
The application made by the firm/company, shall be signed by a person holding the power of attorney, in which case a copy of power of attorney shall be submitted
Maintenance period or the defect liability period for this work is 12 months from the date of completion of work
As per the Karnataka building and other construction workers welfare cess act 1996, 1% of the bill amount will be deducted from the bills
Tenders will be opened on the due date in presence of the contractor or their Authorized representatives

Debarment of tenderers: The procurement entity may debar tenderer for a period not exceeding 3 years from participation in its tenders following such procedures as may be prescribed on the ground that tenderer is engaged in corrupt or fraudulent practices in competing or executing the contract including misleading the procuring entity or any stage of procurement activity with a fraudulent intention. ( KTPP Act 26A).
As per GO FD 5 EXP-12 /2023 dated 15.05.2023 , the contractor shall be abide to provide e Bank Guarantee towards Security Deposits
The payment of bills of this work will be made as and when the letter of credit is received under the same head of account from KNNL/Government of Karnataka
The contractors should adhere to the accepted action plan submitted by him under any circumstances without linking to the pending bill payment of the work
Typo-graphical errors if any will not be the ground for any claims by the Contractor
Tendering by the joint venture will not be allowed
The contractor should furnish the name of the individual /firm with address and Telephone numbers with place of registration, year of incorporation etc
The tender processing charges paid by the bidders are not refundable even if the tenders are cancelled
Royalty on construction materials and other taxes will be deducted as per prevailing Government orders
The Contractor shall produce the Mineral Dispatch Receipt (MDR) from Department of Mines & Geology for exemption

The tenderer has to make his own arrangement for procurement of all materials required for the work. There is no departmental supply of materials. Contractor should procure only ISI mark materials and submit necessary quality control certificates from the authorized quality control authority, before execution
Sub leasing of work in any form is prohibited

No quarries are approved by KNNL for materials. The quarries considered are for the estimate purpose only. The intending bidders shall visit the site, identify the quarries, ascertain availability for the quantity and quality of the materials required for the work and shall quote his rates accordingly. No extra claim whatsoever will be entertained in this regard

The rates includes all leads and lifts and work shall be carried out as per the instruction of Engineer-in-charge .All specifications are as per relevant IS codes in vogue and Indian Road Congress. The rates for the specification in the Schedule B includes all lead and lifts irrespective of the distance and height, no extra claim will be entertained for additional lead and lifts
The validity period of EMD shall be for a minimum period of 225 days from the date of opening of the tenders
The EMD of the unsuccessful bidder will be refunded only after the acceptance of the tender by the competent authority as per tender clause
The Contractor shall be abide to pay any revision of GST during the tender period
The tender inviting authority has got right either accepting tender or rejecting the tender without assigning any reasons

In case of death of contractor after executing the agreement commencement of the work , his legal heir if any eligible registered contractor and willing can execute and complete the work at the accepted tender rates irrespective of the cost of the work

EMD amount and Amount put to tender will be as mentioned in the e-portal of respective work.Further information can be had from the office of the Executive Engineer , Office of the Executive Engineer, KNNL MRBC Division No.3, Byahatti during office hours. Contact Phone. No- 0838-231522
